content: प्रव्रजित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Gone abroad or into exile. .²2 Turned a recluse. .{@-तः@} .²1 A religious mendicant or ascetic in general. .²2 Especially, a Brāhmaṇa who has entered on the fourth (भिक्षु) order. .²3 The pupil of a Jaina or Buddhist mendicant. .{@-ता@} .²1 A female ascetic. .²2 A spikenard. .{@-तम्@} Turning a recluse, the life of a religious mendicant.
